test_griffin_numerically_to_jax: test the Griffin model numerically matches JAX implementation with configurable parameters
create_griffin_config: create a GriffinConfig with vocab size, width, mlp expanded width, and attention window size
build_griffin_torch_module: build a PyTorch Griffin module from a GriffinConfig with specified dtype
compare_jax_torch_modules: compare JAX and PyTorch Griffin modules numerically using test_utils.numerically_compare_modules
run_griffin_test_suite: run the GriffinTest test suite with parameterized configurations via absltest
